en.title: Consortium Meeting 2025
en.summary: Our next consortium meeting will be held in-person in Wädenswil on 4-5 September 2025.
en.body:
The EDGE consortium meets twice a year.

Our next consortium meeting will be held in-person in Wädenswil on 4-5 September 2025.

The EDGE consortium meets twice a year to exchange ideas, reflect on progress, and plan the next steps. This edition will feature:

🔍 New findings on finance, market design, and grid integration.

🚗 Updates on electric mobility, local energy communities, and agricultural transport.

🏔️ Deep dives into Alpine and Midlands case studies.

📊 Preparations for the next Renewable Energy Outlook.

🌱 Campus garden tour and optional fish farming visit.

We look forward to having consortium members joining us as we shape the next phase of EDGE!
